NAME: EP_AFTER_INSERT
SOURCE:
AS
DECLARE VARIABLE last_pos_date TIMESTAMP;
BEGIN
    SELECT ES_POS_DATE
      FROM EQUIP_STATUS
      WHERE ES_ID = NEW.EP_ID
      INTO :last_pos_date;
    /* Only update if current pos'n date is > the last pos'n date */
    if (NEW.EP_DATE <= last_pos_date) then
        EXIT;
    UPDATE EQUIP_STATUS
        SET ES_POS_CITY = NEW.EP_CITY,
            ES_POS_STATE = NEW.EP_STATE,
            ES_POS_DISTANCE = NEW.EP_DISTANCE,
            ES_POS_BEARING = NEW.EP_BEARING,
            ES_POS_DIRECTION = NEW.EP_DIRECTION,
            ES_POS_LATITUDE = NEW.EP_LATITUDE,
            ES_POS_NS = NEW.EP_NS,
            ES_POS_LONGITUDE = NEW.EP_LONGITUDE,
            ES_POS_EW = NEW.EP_EW,
            ES_POS_DATE = NEW.EP_DATE
        WHERE ES_ID = NEW.EP_ID;
END

NAME: OPS_HEADER_AFTER_DELETE
OPS_HEADER_AFTER_INSERT
SOURCE:
AS
declare variable rsn D_DESC;
begin
    /* This trigger adds a record to the load history when a load is created */
    rsn = '';
    if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'O') then
    begin
        rsn = 'Order created';
    end else if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'M') then
    begin
        rsn = 'Manifest created';
    end else if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'T') THEN
    begin
      rsn = 'Template Created';
    end else if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'Q') THEN
    BEGIN
      rsn = 'Rate Quote Created';
    end 
    if (rsn <> '') then
    begin
        INSERT INTO OPS_HISTORY
            (OPH_ORDER_ID, OPH_SEQUENCE, OPH_STOP_ID, OPH_TIME, OPH_INITIALS, OPH_REASON,
             OPH_STATUS)
            VALUES
            (NEW.PB_ID, GEN_ID(HIST_GEN, 1), 0, NEW.PB_DT_ENT, NEW.PB_ORDER_ENTERED_INIT,
             :rsn, NEW.PB_STATUS);
    end
end

NAME: OPS_HEADER_AFTER_UPDATE
SOURCE:
AS
declare variable rsn VARCHAR(1000);
declare variable dt TIMESTAMP;
declare variable init D_INITIALS;
begin
    /* This trigger adds a record to the load history when a load is modified */
    rsn = '';
    if (COALESCE(CAST(OLD.PB_DT_CANC AS VARCHAR(30)), '') <>
        COALESCE(CAST(NEW.PB_DT_CANC AS VARCHAR(30)), '')) then
    begin
        if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'O') then
        begin            
            if (coalesce(cast(new.pb_dt_canc as varchar(30)), '') = '') THEN
            begin
               rsn = 'Order un-canceled';
               init = NEW.PB_ORDER_MODIFIED_INIT;
               dt = CAST('NOW' AS TIMESTAMP);
            end
            else
            begin
               rsn = 'Order canceled';
               init = NEW.PBCINIT;
               dt = NEW.PB_DT_CANC;
            end
        end else if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'M') then
        begin
            if (coalesce(cast(new.pb_dt_canc as varchar(30)), '') = '') THEN
            begin
               rsn = 'Manifest un-canceled';
               init = NEW.PB_ORDER_MODIFIED_INIT;
               dt = CAST('NOW' AS TIMESTAMP);
            end
            else
            begin
               rsn = 'Manifest canceled';
               init = NEW.PBCINIT;
               dt = NEW.PB_DT_CANC;
            end
        end
    end else
    begin
        dt = NEW.PB_ORDER_MODIFIED_TIME;
        if (COALESCE(OLD.PB_STATUS, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_STATUS, 0)) then
        begin
            if (NEW.PB_STATUS = 30) then
            begin
              rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'DAT Queued, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);           
            end
            else
            begin
              if (NEW.PB_STATUS = 31) then
              begin
                rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'DAT Posted, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);           
              end
              else
              begin
                if (NEW.PB_STATUS = 32) then
                begin
                  rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'DAT ERROR, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);           
                end
                else
                begin
                  if (NEW.PB_STATUS = 33) then
                  begin
                    rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'DAT Attention, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);           
                  end
                  else
                  begin
                    rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'Status changed, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);           
                  end
                end
              end
            end
        end
        if ((COALESCE(OLD.PB_STATUS_LOCATION, '') <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_STATUS_LOCATION,  '')) OR
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_STATUS_LOC_TYPE, '') <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_STATUS_LOC_TYPE, ''))) then
        begin
            rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'Location changed, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);
        end
        if (COALESCE(CAST(OLD.PB_DT_RATE AS VARCHAR(30)), '') <>
            COALESCE(CAST(NEW.PB_DT_RATE AS VARCHAR(30)), '')) then
        begin
            rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'Revenue date changed, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);
        end
        if ((COALESCE(OLD.PB_CURRENT_DRIVER, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_CURRENT_DRIVER, 0)) or
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_CURRENT_DRIVER2, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_CURRENT_DRIVER2, 0)) or
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_CURRENT_TRACTOR, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_CURRENT_TRACTOR, 0)) or
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_CURRENT_TRAILER, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_CURRENT_TRAILER, 0))) then
        begin
            rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'Equip changed, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);
        end
        if ((COALESCE(OLD.PBTOTBIL, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PBTOTBIL, 0)) OR
            (COALESCE(OLD.PBCREV, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PBCREV, 0)) OR
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_TOTAL_FRT, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_TOTAL_FRT, 0)) OR
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_TOTAL_ASC, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_TOTAL_ASC, 0)) OR
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_TOTAL_FUEL_REV, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_TOTAL_FUEL_REV, 0)) OR
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_TOTAL_DISC_REV, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_TOTAL_DISC_REV, 0)) OR
            (COALESCE(OLD.PB_IL_REV, 0) <> COALESCE(NEW.PB_IL_REV, 0))) then
        begin
            rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'Revenue changed, ' FROM 1 FOR 200);
        end
        if (((coalesce(old.pb_bill_id,'') <> coalesce(new.pb_bill_id, '')) or
            (coalesce(old.pbbname, '') <> coalesce(new.pbbname, ''))) AND
            (coalesce(old.pbbname, '') <> '')) then
        BEGIN
          rsn = substring(rsn || ' BillTo Chgd from ' from 1 for 200);
          rsn = substring(rsn || old.pbbname from 1 for 200);
          rsn = substring(rsn || ' To ' from 1 for 200);
          rsn = substring(rsn || new.pbbname from 1 for 200);
          rsn = substring(rsn || ', ' from 1 for 200);
        end
        
        if (rsn <> '') then
        begin
            if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'O') then
            begin
                rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'Order modified' FROM 1 FOR 200);
            end else if (NEW.PB_TYPE = 'M') then
            begin
                rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn || 'Manifest modified' FROM 1 FOR 200);
            end
        end
        init = NEW.PB_ORDER_MODIFIED_INIT;
    end
    if (rsn <> '') then
    begin
        dt = CAST('NOW' AS TIMESTAMP);
  
        INSERT INTO OPS_HISTORY
            (OPH_ORDER_ID, OPH_SEQUENCE, OPH_STOP_ID, OPH_TIME, OPH_INITIALS, OPH_REASON,
             OPH_STATUS, OPH_STATUS_TIME, OPH_LOCATION, OPH_LOC_TYPE, OPH_EDI_REASON,
             OPH_STATUS_COMMENT, OPH_204_ACCEPTED, OPH_PRIOR_STATUS, OPH_PRIOR_STATUS_TIME,
             OPH_DRIVER1, OPH_DRIVER2, OPH_TRACTOR, OPH_TRAILER)
            VALUES
            (NEW.PB_ID, GEN_ID(HIST_GEN, 1), 0, :dt, :init,
             :rsn, NEW.PB_STATUS, NEW.PB_STATUS_TIME, NEW.PB_STATUS_LOCATION,
             NEW.PB_STATUS_LOC_TYPE, NEW.PB_EDI_REASON, NEW.PB_STATUS_COMMENT,
             NEW.PB_204_ACCEPTED, OLD.PB_STATUS, OLD.PB_STATUS_TIME,
             NEW.PB_CURRENT_DRIVER, NEW.PB_CURRENT_DRIVER2, NEW.PB_CURRENT_TRACTOR,
             NEW.PB_CURRENT_TRAILER);
    end
end

NAME: OPS_STOP_REC_AFTER_UPDATE
OPS_STOP_REC_BEFORE_UPDATE
SOURCE:
AS
declare variable rsn VARCHAR(1000);
begin
    /*
     * This trigger updates the load history if the values of certain
     * key fields change.
    */
    rsn = '';

    if ((coalesce(OLD.OPS_CHEETAH, 'N') = 'N') and (coalesce(NEW.OPS_CHEETAH, 'N') = 'Y')) then
    begin
      if (coalesce(NEW.OPS_TYPE, '') = 'P') then 
      begin
        rsn = rsn || ',Cheetah Pickup created.';
      end
    end

    if ((coalesce(OLD.OPS_CHEETAH, 'N') = 'N') and (coalesce(NEW.OPS_CHEETAH, 'N') = 'Y')) then
    begin
      if (coalesce(NEW.OPS_TYPE, '') = 'D') then 
      begin
        rsn = rsn || ',Cheetah Delivery created.';
      end
    end

    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_STATUS, 0) <> (COALESCE(NEW.OPS_STATUS, 0))) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Status chgd';
    if (SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(OLD.OPS_STATUS_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16) <>
        SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(NEW.OPS_STATUS_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16)) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Status time chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_DRIVER1, 0) <> (COALESCE(NEW.OPS_DRIVER1, 0))) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Driver1 chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_DRIVER2, 0) <> (COALESCE(NEW.OPS_DRIVER2, 0))) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Driver2 chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_TRACTOR, 0) <> (COALESCE(NEW.OPS_TRACTOR, 0))) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Tractor chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_TRAILER, 0) <> (COALESCE(NEW.OPS_TRAILER, 0))) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Trailer chgd';
    if ((COALESCE(OLD.OPS_LOC_TYPE,  '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_LOC_TYPE, '')) or
        (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_LOCATION, '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_LOCATION,  ''))) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Location chgd';
    if (SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(OLD.OPS_APPT_LOW AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16) <>
        SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(NEW.OPS_APPT_LOW AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16)) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Appt time chgd';
    if (SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(OLD.OPS_ARRIVE_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16) <>
        SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(NEW.OPS_ARRIVE_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16)) then

        SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(NEW.OPS_DEPART_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1  FOR 16)) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Depart time chgd';

        SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(NEW.OPS_BACKIN_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16)) then

        SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(NEW.OPS_RELEASE_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16)) then

        SUBSTRING(COALESCE(CAST(NEW.OPS_MANIFESTED_TIME AS VARCHAR(30)), '') FROM 1 FOR 16)) then

    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_EDI_REASON,  '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_EDI_REASON, '')) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Reason chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_ARRIVE_REASON,  '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_ARRIVE_REASON, '')) then
        rsn = rsn || ',ARI Reason chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_BACKIN_REASON,  '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_BACKIN_REASON, '')) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Bkin Reason chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_RELEASE_REASON,  '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_RELEASE_REASON, '')) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Rel Reason chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_DEPART_REASON,  '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_DEPART_REASON, '')) then
        rsn = rsn || ', Dep Reason chgd';
    if (COALESCE(OLD.OPS_APPT_REASON,  '') <> COALESCE(NEW.OPS_APPT_REASON, '')) then
        rsn = rsn || ',Appt Reason chgd';
    rsn = SUBSTRING(rsn FROM 1 FOR 200);
    NEW.OPS_STATUS_REASON  = SUBSTRING(rsn FROM 2);
    if ((rsn <> '') and (COALESCE(NEW.OPS_WRITE_HISTORY, ' ') <> 'N')) then
    begin
        INSERT INTO OPS_HISTORY
          (OPH_ORDER_ID, OPH_SEQUENCE, OPH_STOP_ID, OPH_TIME,
           OPH_INITIALS, OPH_STATUS, OPH_STATUS_TIME, OPH_LOC_TYPE,
           OPH_LOCATION, OPH_APPT_TIME, OPH_ARRIVE_TIME, OPH_DEPART_TIME, OPH_BACKIN_TIME,
           OPH_RELEASE_TIME, OPH_DISPATCH_TIME, OPH_ONBOARD_TIME,
           OPH_DELIVERED_TIME, OPH_RECOVERED_TIME, OPH_OVER, OPH_SHORT,
           OPH_DAMAGED, OPH_DRIVER1, OPH_DRIVER2, OPH_TRACTOR, OPH_TRAILER,
           OPH_REASON, OPH_EDI_REASON, OPH_STATUS_COMMENT, OPH_PRIOR_STATUS,
           OPH_PRIOR_APPT_TIME, OPH_PRIOR_ARRIVE_TIME, OPH_PRIOR_DEPART_TIME,
           OPH_PRIOR_BACKIN_TIME, OPH_PRIOR_RELEASE_TIME, OPH_MANIFEST_NUMBER,
           OPH_MANIFESTED_TIME, OPH_PRIOR_STATUS_TIME, OPH_PRIOR_EDI_REASON,
           OPH_ARRIVE_REASON, OPH_BACKIN_REASON, OPH_RELEASE_REASON, OPH_DEPART_REASON,
           OPH_APPT_REASON, OPH_PRIOR_ARRIVE_REASON, OPH_PRIOR_BACKIN_REASON,
           OPH_PRIOR_RELEASE_REASON, OPH_PRIOR_DEPART_REASON, OPH_PRIOR_APPT_REASON,
           OPH_PRIOR_OVER, OPH_PRIOR_SHORT, OPH_PRIOR_DAMAGED, OPH_PRIOR_ONBOARD_TIME,
           OPH_PRIOR_DELIVERED_TIME)
          VALUES
          (NEW.OPS_ORDER_ID, GEN_ID(HIST_GEN, 1), NEW.OPS_STOP_ID, 'NOW',
           NEW.OPS_UPDATED_BY, NEW.OPS_STATUS, NEW.OPS_STATUS_TIME, NEW.OPS_LOC_TYPE,
           NEW.OPS_LOCATION, NEW.OPS_APPT_LOW, NEW.OPS_ARRIVE_TIME, NEW.OPS_DEPART_TIME, NEW.OPS_BACKIN_TIME,
           NEW.OPS_RELEASE_TIME, NEW.OPS_DISPATCH_TIME, NEW.OPS_ONBOARD_TIME,
           NEW.OPS_DELIVERED_TIME, NEW.OPS_RECOVERED_TIME, NEW.OPS_OVER, NEW.OPS_SHORT,
           NEW.OPS_DAMAGED, NEW.OPS_DRIVER1, NEW.OPS_DRIVER2, NEW.OPS_TRACTOR, NEW.OPS_TRAILER,
           NEW.OPS_STATUS_REASON, NEW.OPS_EDI_REASON, NEW.OPS_STATUS_COMMENT,
           OLD.OPS_STATUS, OLD.OPS_APPT_LOW, OLD.OPS_ARRIVE_TIME, OLD.OPS_DEPART_TIME,
           OLD.OPS_BACKIN_TIME, OLD.OPS_RELEASE_TIME, NEW.OPS_MANIFEST_NUMBER,
           NEW.OPS_MANIFESTED_TIME, OLD.OPS_STATUS_TIME, OLD.OPS_EDI_REASON,
           NEW.OPS_ARRIVE_REASON, NEW.OPS_BACKIN_REASON, NEW.OPS_RELEASE_REASON,
           NEW.OPS_DEPART_REASON, NEW.OPS_APPT_REASON, OLD.OPS_ARRIVE_REASON,
           OLD.OPS_BACKIN_REASON,  OLD.OPS_RELEASE_REASON, OLD.OPS_DEPART_REASON,
           OLD.OPS_APPT_REASON, OLD.OPS_OVER, OLD.OPS_SHORT,  OLD.OPS_DAMAGED,
           OLD.OPS_ONBOARD_TIME, OLD.OPS_DELIVERED_TIME);
    end
    NEW.OPS_WRITE_HISTORY = NULL;
end

NAME: PN_ACTIVITIES_BEFORE_INSERT
SOURCE:
AS
begin
    /* If no activity ID is provided by the application,
       assign a new activity ID. IDs assigned here must be
       > 10, since those <= 10 have special meaning to
       the application.
    */
    if (COALESCE(NEW.PNA_ID, 0) = 0) then
    begin
        NEW.PNA_ID = 0;
        while (NEW.PNA_ID <= 10) do
        begin
            NEW.PNA_ID = GEN_ID(PN_ACTIVITIES_GEN, 1);
        end
    end
end
